Maya Chen: Heads-up 11 I signed up for a coworking membership in Boulder and plan to work there roughly 3 days/week starting next Monday. My official home base remains SF. Do I need to file anything so stipend / payroll / benefits are handled correctly?
Sam Patel: Good question. Short version: yes, please declare recurring satellite work. Its not a relocation but it can change payroll withholding and stipend proration depending on frequency.
Maya Chen: OK. Im not moving my residence, just splitting time.
Jordan (Payroll): Key things we need: coworking address, expected days/week, start date, and a short note from your manager confirming arrangement. If regular use exceeds ~30 calendar days in a year, we typically trigger a state nexus review and may need to withhold CO taxes.
Ava (Manager): Confirmed from my side 11 Mayas schedule approved. No product impact.
Sam Patel: For WFH stipend: Redwood pays a monthly allowance for your primary declared workspace. For periodic satellite use we generally do one of: a) no change to monthly stipend but a one-time accommodation payment for setup, or b) switch primary workspace if the employee permanently changes homebase. Since youre keeping SF as home base, expect the former. Manager can request a different handling if needed.
Maya Chen: Wheres the form?
Sam Patel: Internal link: https://redwood.internal/people-ops/forms/remote-location-declaration. Please attach proof of recurring use (membership invoice, recurring booking screenshot).
Jordan (Payroll): Also note payroll cutoff rules: cutoff is 11:59PM PT on the 15th and last day of each month. Submit before cutoff to have changes assessed for the next payroll cycle. Assessment + processing ETA is ~3-10 biz days.
Maya Chen: Submitted the form and attached the monthly membership PDF.
PeopleOps Bot: Form received: Remote Work Location Declaration (1901761234-01).
Jordan (Payroll): Received. Well triage, run a quick nexus check, and follow up if CO withholding or additional tax forms are required. If multiple Redwoood employees start regular CO work, we may need to register the company for employer taxes in CO 11 thats on the company side, not you.
Sam Patel: FYI benefits remain tied to your legal homebase (SF) unless you formally change your homebase. Health/dental not impacted by satellite location.
Maya Chen: Awesome, thanks. Will update you if I increase days or move permanently.
Sam Patel: Thanks Maya 11 well post the payroll decision here once done. :thumbsup:
